source: Completed GitHub Actions job log; public machine-readable markers. Raw user save documents are not included.

SAVE_ADMISSION_COMPARISON:.control: Current SaveManager versus the same source with only the four redundant schema validations restored. Same current schemas, parse cache enabled, identical retained source bytes, one new isolated process per sample.
SAVE_ADMISSION_COMPARISON:.sampling: Eight matched pairs / sixteen processes; odd pairs baseline then candidate, even pairs candidate then baseline. Shared Windows runner; process-cold Login, not flushed OS filesystem caches or physical input-to-paint.

MANUAL_SAVE_WRITE_COMPARISON:.control: Public prepare_backup_action and commit_backup_action with real storage, the same seeded Day7 journal, immutable capture fixture and a test-subclass fixed clock. Only the write validation memo differs; parse cache enabled in both.
MANUAL_SAVE_WRITE_COMPARISON:.sampling: Eight alternating pairs / sixteen fresh isolated processes; identical prepared candidate, physical source files, target revision and pre-commit parser cache. Commit timing excludes preparation, live UI callbacks, issuer-flush callbacks and rendering. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.

SEVEN_DAY_HISTORY_PROOF:.fixture: 7 synthetic line and 7 synthetic manual checkpoint records/day, plus one real Slot 1 save and App loss/day. Public Schedule Done advances to Day 7. This is not an authored-dialogue playthrough.
SEVEN_DAY_HISTORY_PROOF:.timing_policy: Observations on one shared Windows runner; no speed threshold or physical input-to-paint guarantee.

timing_boundaries.manual_slot_save_us: Production prepare_backup_action(save, slot:1) plus commit_backup_action, including synchronous signal handlers.
timing_boundaries.login_us: Automated Title Login, Backup picker opening and Autosave selection, load consent, restore and awaited process frames.
timing_boundaries.phase_scopes: Each scope is inclusive. Parent and child scopes overlap and must not be summed; repeated phases inside one scope accumulate.
timing_boundaries.phase_collection: Save/load profiles include only labeled manual-save and Title Login measurement windows; startup and opening each daily Backup app before its save timer are excluded.

parse_cache_comparison.control: Same checkout and retained user-data source, cloned into a new isolated process per variant. Only DWM_SAVE_PARSE_CACHE_DISABLED differs.
parse_cache_comparison.sampling: One cold Login per variant, fixed disabled-then-enabled order on one shared Windows runner; observational, not a repeated-sample or frame-time guarantee.
